capabilities: create a canvas from a note via the Create Canvas From File Links command
embed incoming backlinks and their linked notes onto the canvas
embed outgoing links and their linked notes onto the canvas
set the destination folder of the created canvas
extras: README notes this is a first release that is very basic; the Examples section has no visible content, and installation points to the plugin marketplace.
intentEvidence: An interactive version of your local graph.
problem: Obsidian's local graph shows link relationships visually but is not interactive, and manually embedding linked notes onto a canvas is tedious.
summary: Canvas generator that creates a canvas from a note, embedding its incoming backlinks and outgoing links plus their linked notes.
